title: warn when repo-private workspace_root shadows global scope
description: A repo-private workspace_root intentionally beats everything in load() (config.rs), which also shadows the global scope (rules.md) for that repo — a repo can lose sight of global rules with no warning. GH issue #1 follow-up: add a docs note and/or a turu check/turu doctor warning when a repo-private root is set and the global rules.md diverges from the shadowed one.

title: fix: anchor relative repo workspace_root to config dir, not cwd
description: Repo-private .whisper/config.toml with relative workspace_root resolves against process cwd instead of the dir containing the config. find_repo_config() discards the config dir in load(); expand_tilde passes relative paths through unanchored. Running turu from a subdir silently creates a stray workspace tree (split-brain notes). GH issue #1. Fix: anchor relative repo workspace_root to the config dir; red test per repo TDD convention.

title: Decide shared-bundle transport (in-repo dir vs git-refs vs remote)
description: Strategic fork documented in openspec/changes/add-shared-bundle/design.md — deliberately deferred until real multi-machine/team usage exists. The bundle primitive (deterministic pack/unpack, shipped in v0.4.0) is the common substrate all three options consume. Options: A) committed .whisper/ dir in-repo (zero transport, PR noise), B) bundles under git refs on the existing remote (beads-style, no working-tree noise), C) central remote store (violates ownership maxim, infra to run). Decide when a second machine/team actually needs shared knowledge.
